source_semantics: Refresh preview re-reads the current maintenance storage and retention preview without executing cleanup or another mutation.
The refresh control has deterministic loading, refreshed, and fail-closed error feedback.
The existing tenant-scoped SiteOperationHistoryService read runtime is reused rather than introducing a second maintenance architecture.
The response is bound to the exact selected operation and does not terminalize the separate ReloadAsync operation.
security: caller cannot supply site, history, cleanup, or retention mutation identifiers
refresh transport is GET-only and does not call cleanup or clear operations
